title: ADR-0087 still defines each step's D3 `semantic` list as "the residue D2 cannot express losslessly", contradicting ruling B on #17152 (one D3 entry per retirement family, even when a lossless D2 conversion exists)
body:
Filing gate ① — a defect with a named landing site, finding class (b): governed text that contradicts a recorded ruling.

**Reader, and what they do:** the `domain:skills` seat, because `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface. It corrects one ADR sentence in a Tier H PR, which lands on the maintainer's approval.

**Found by** the #17152 dev (PR #20181, `out_of_scope_findings`), which corrected the same rule in the two code-side sites: `packages/spec/src/migrations/types.ts` and the hand-written header of `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_01QcAS3qiYYZNezaxZxaUdMV`, seat post #18549). ⛔ Not graded or routed here.

## The ruling

#17152 was ruled **B** (director seat, class-one self-adjudication `5615360777`, restated at `5634031140`) on the authority of the maintainer's ruling on #15954 (comment `5559778263`, verbatim 「one ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry **per family** … its D3 entry says so」). Ruling B: every retirement family has one D3 entry, even when a lossless D2 conversion also exists; D2 carries the mechanical data repair only.

## The contradicting text (`origin/main`)

`docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`, the migration-chain paragraph (around line 175): 「Two sources feed each major's step: **semantic changes** authored for that major (the residue D2 cannot express losslessly), and **graduated conversions** (D2 entries retired from the load path).」

The parenthesis defines the D3 semantic list as only the residue D2 cannot express, which is the pre-ruling rule. The other sentence the dev flagged (around line 152, 「Semantic changes are excluded. A change whose old shape has no lossless mapping cannot be converted; it goes to D3.」) states D2's scope and does not contradict ruling B. ⛔ It needs no change.

**Reach:** a named producer. Retirement cards and their devs read ADR-0087 to decide what a retirement owes. Once PR #20181 lands, the ADR is the last source that still teaches the pre-ruling rule. The contradiction is what #17152 was filed about: 「这个约定每张退役卡都会再撞一次」.

## Dedupe

Query (`mcp__github__search_issues`, repo-scoped, semantic, closed included): `ADR-0087 text semantic D3 entries only for residue D2 cannot express losslessly contradicts one D3 entry per retirement family ruling` → 8 hits, 0 duplicates. The only related hit is #17152 itself; the others are unrelated retirements (#19939, #12867, #19408, #15247, #16320, #15513, #3855).
